request.text:
Under the canopy, every colony keeps one law above the rest: the Queen tends the brood.

Aurelith had worn the crown for a single winter. From the high balconies of the Spire she could watch her whole colony wake: workers at the amber stores, soldiers at the gates, nurses carrying the young up into the light.

voice.description: A wise elderly woman narrator: deep, rich and velvety, calm and a little solemn, with long pauses and a hint of mystery in her voice. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, clearly and unhurried, close to the microphone in a quiet room, as if telling a tale to children by lantern light.
